summary: Removed the duplicate domainId→integrations fallback in pi-session-factory, renamed the internal PiSessionLike.domains field to enabledExtensionIds (keeping `domains` only on the protocol wire), and consolidated scattered Unity/tool-result CSS into the unity extension bundle while stripping the corresponding blocks from app stylesheets.
decisions: PiSessionLike.domains was renamed to enabledExtensionIds because `domains` collides with the protocol's legacy wire name and is misleading when carrying active extension IDs.

session-runtime-pool.ts keeps emitting `domains` on the protocol event because `domains` is the protocol-v25 wire name for enabled extension IDs, while the internal session object now uses enabledExtensionIds.
pi-session-factory.ts no longer derives `integrations` from `options.domainId`; callers must pass integrations explicitly (defaults to []).

Tool-result and editor-result CSS for the unity extension now lives in packages/unity/src/web/unity/tool-results.css and is imported by UnityToolResult.svelte, rather than being inherited from app/tool-call-parts stylesheets.
errors: vitest run for @gizmo/agent-server reported one failing test, tests/extensions/registry-git-build.test.ts > 'only reports an update when the source HEAD changes', with a 5000ms timeout followed by EBUSY on rmdir of a temp clone directory. Re-running that single file with --testTimeout=15000 passed, indicating a flaky filesystem/timing issue rather than a real regression.
